cards.example_en: Our boots were covered in mud after the walk.
cards.example_zh: 散步回来后，我们的靴子上沾满了泥。
cards.explain_zh: mud通常不可数；形容泥泞用muddy。

cards.example_en: Our boots were covered in mud after the walk.
cards.example_zh: 散步回来后，我们的靴子上沾满了泥。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Everyone involved in the picnic brought something to share.
cards.example_zh: 参加野餐的每个人都带了东西与大家分享。
cards.explain_zh: 参与某事用be involved in；修饰名词可后置。

cards.example_en: Residents should be actively involved in planning decisions that affect the future of their neighbourhoods.
cards.example_zh: 居民应积极参与影响社区未来的规划决策。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We sent the parcel by airmail yesterday morning.
cards.example_zh: 我们昨天上午通过航空邮递寄出了包裹。
cards.explain_zh: 表示寄送方式用by airmail，不加冠词。

cards.example_en: We sent the parcel by airmail yesterday morning.
cards.example_zh: 我们昨天上午通过航空邮递寄出了包裹。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The police found my stolen bicycle behind a garage.
cards.example_zh: 警察在一个车库后面找到了我被偷的自行车。
cards.explain_zh: 变化为steal—stole—stolen；stolen不能单独作过去式。

cards.example_en: Please keep your bicycle off the crowded sidewalk.
cards.example_zh: 请不要把自行车骑上拥挤的人行道。
cards.explain_zh: 美式sidewalk对应英式pavement。

cards.example_en: Please keep your bicycle off the crowded sidewalk.
cards.example_zh: 请不要把自行车骑上拥挤的人行道。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I bought a secondhand bicycle from my neighbour.
cards.example_zh: 我从邻居那里买了一辆二手自行车。
cards.explain_zh: 也常写作second-hand；信息义指非亲身所得。

cards.example_en: Buying secondhand furniture can reduce household spending and limit the environmental impact of producing new goods.
cards.example_zh: 购买二手家具可以减少家庭开支，并降低生产新商品对环境的影响。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We joined a guided walk through the forest yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 昨天我们参加了一次有向导带领的森林徒步。
cards.explain_zh: guided tour指有导游的游览；guided也是guide的过去分词。

cards.example_en: We joined a guided walk through the forest yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 昨天我们参加了一次有向导带领的森林徒步。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.meaning_zh: 令人恶心的；令人反感的
cards.example_en: A disgusting smell came from the forgotten rubbish bag.
cards.example_zh: 那个被遗忘的垃圾袋散发出一股令人恶心的气味。
cards.explain_zh: disgusting形容事物令人反感；disgusted形容人感到反感。

cards.example_en: A disgusting smell came from the forgotten rubbish bag.
cards.example_zh: 那个被遗忘的垃圾袋散发出一股令人恶心的气味。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Restoring a historic cathedral can preserve traditional craftsmanship while attracting visitors who support the local economy.
cards.example_zh: 修复历史悠久的大教堂既能保护传统工艺，也能吸引游客，支持当地经济。
cards.explain_zh: 严格指主教驻地的教堂，并非所有大型教堂。

cards.example_en: An unpleasant smell was coming from the kitchen bin.
cards.example_zh: 厨房垃圾桶里散发出一股难闻的气味。
cards.explain_zh: 形容事物表示令人不快；形容人常指态度不友善。

cards.example_en: An unpleasant smell was coming from the kitchen bin.
cards.example_zh: 厨房垃圾桶里散发出一股难闻的气味。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The neighbours smiled and greeted us warmly this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上，邻居们微笑着热情地向我们打招呼。
cards.explain_zh: greet warmly指热情问候；dress warmly指穿暖和。

cards.example_en: Our swimming instructor showed us how to breathe properly.
cards.example_zh: 我们的游泳教练教我们如何正确呼吸。
cards.explain_zh: 常指教授驾驶、游泳等具体技能的人。

cards.example_en: A qualified instructor can help older adults exercise safely and develop confidence in their physical abilities.
cards.example_zh: 合格的教练能帮助老年人安全锻炼，并增强他们对自身体能的信心。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We found a quiet motel just outside the town.
cards.example_zh: 我们在镇子外找到了一家安静的汽车旅馆。
cards.explain_zh: motel主要服务驾车旅客，通常提供便利停车位。

cards.meaning_zh: 男运动员；男性运动爱好者
cards.example_en: My uncle was a keen sportsman in his youth.
cards.example_zh: 我叔叔年轻时非常热爱运动。
cards.explain_zh: 特指男性；不强调性别时可用athlete。

cards.example_en: My uncle was a keen sportsman in his youth.
cards.example_zh: 我叔叔年轻时非常热爱运动。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Her gentle humour made everyone at dinner feel relaxed.
cards.example_zh: 她温和的幽默让晚餐时的每个人都放松了下来。
cards.explain_zh: 英式拼写humour，美式humor；作动词表示迁就。

cards.example_en: I checked the tag before washing my new jumper.
cards.example_zh: 洗新毛衣前，我查看了标签。
cards.explain_zh: 动词过去式tagged；tag along意为跟着去。

cards.example_en: We watched a swimmer dive smoothly into the pool.
cards.example_zh: 我们看着一名游泳者流畅地跃入泳池。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式英式常用dived，美式也用dove。

cards.example_en: We watched seabirds nesting halfway up the cliff.
cards.example_zh: 我们看着海鸟在悬崖半腰筑巢。
cards.explain_zh: cliff强调陡峭岩壁，不泛指山坡。

cards.example_en: We picked up litter along the beach before lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭前，我们沿着海滩捡垃圾。
cards.explain_zh: 垃圾义不可数；一窝幼崽用a litter of。

cards.example_en: Please don't pollute the stream by throwing rubbish into it.
cards.example_zh: 请不要往小溪里扔垃圾，污染溪水。
cards.explain_zh: 及物动词，直接接被污染的对象，不加介词。

cards.example_en: We roasted a pumpkin and served it with rice.
cards.example_zh: 我们烤了一个南瓜，配米饭一起吃。
cards.explain_zh: 整个南瓜可数；表示作为食材的南瓜时常不可数。

cards.example_en: A volunteer handed me a leaflet about the new library.
cards.example_zh: 一位志愿者递给我一张介绍新图书馆的传单。
cards.explain_zh: leaflet通常是单页或折页；brochure通常为小册子。

cards.example_en: A medium-sized suitcase should hold everything for the weekend.
cards.example_zh: 一个中等大小的行李箱应该能装下周末所需的所有东西。
cards.explain_zh: 表示大小适中，不表示质量或水平普通。

cards.example_en: A medium-sized suitcase should hold everything for the weekend.
cards.example_zh: 一个中等大小的行李箱应该能装下周末所需的所有东西。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: She wrapped a soft blanket around her cold shoulders.
cards.example_zh: 她用一条柔软的毯子裹住冰凉的肩膀。
cards.explain_zh: blanket作形容词指全面适用，如blanket ban。

cards.example_en: A blanket ban on private vehicles may disadvantage residents who cannot easily access public transport.
cards.example_zh: 全面禁止私家车可能使难以使用公共交通的居民处于不利地位。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: An empty glass ashtray stood on the outdoor table.
cards.example_zh: 室外的桌子上放着一个空玻璃烟灰缸。
cards.explain_zh: 可数名词，由ash（灰）和tray（托盘）组成。

cards.example_en: Fresh ginger is the main ingredient in this soup.
cards.example_zh: 鲜姜是这道汤的主要食材。
cards.explain_zh: 是可数名词；既指烹饪配料，也可比喻必要因素。

cards.example_en: Fresh ginger is the main ingredient in this soup.
cards.example_zh: 鲜姜是这道汤的主要食材。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I sent my neighbour an apology for the noise.
cards.example_zh: 我为制造噪声向邻居致歉。
cards.explain_zh: 向某人道歉用apology to someone for something。

cards.example_en: Small fishing boats returned to the harbour before sunset.
cards.example_zh: 小渔船在日落前回到了港湾。
cards.explain_zh: 英式拼写harbour，美式拼写harbor。

cards.example_en: Please send written instructions so I can follow them.
cards.example_zh: 请把书面说明发来，方便我照着做。
cards.explain_zh: write的变化为write–wrote–written。

cards.example_en: Written feedback allows students to review their mistakes and improve their performance over time.
cards.example_zh: 书面反馈让学生能够回顾错误，并逐步提高表现。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: With spare batteries packed, we were prepared for a blackout.
cards.example_zh: 备用电池已经备好，我们做好了应对停电的准备。
cards.explain_zh: prepared for接名词；prepared to do可表愿意。

cards.example_en: We followed the highway along the coast until sunset.
cards.example_zh: 我们沿着海岸公路一直开到日落。
cards.explain_zh: 常见于美式英语；不一定是封闭式高速公路。

cards.example_en: We bought fresh seafood at the harbour this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上我们在港口买了新鲜海鲜。
cards.explain_zh: 通常是不可数名词；一盘海鲜可说a plate of seafood。

cards.example_en: We bought fresh seafood at the harbour this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上我们在港口买了新鲜海鲜。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I chopped some celery and added it to the soup.
cards.example_zh: 我切了些芹菜，放进汤里。
cards.explain_zh: 通常不可数；一根芹菜茎用a stalk of celery。

cards.example_en: She pushed a trolley full of groceries towards the checkout.
cards.example_zh: 她推着装满食品杂货的购物车走向收银台。
cards.explain_zh: 英式购物车用trolley，美式通常用shopping cart。

cards.example_en: The children imagined finding treasure inside the old chest.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们想象着在旧箱子里发现财宝。
cards.explain_zh: 泛指财宝时不可数；指具体珍品时可数。

word.example_en: Guided learning can help students build confidence before they begin working independently on complex tasks.
word.example_zh: 有指导的学习可以帮助学生建立信心，为独立完成复杂任务做好准备。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Public trust is an essential ingredient in the successful implementation of environmental policies.
word.example_zh: 公众信任是成功实施环境政策的必要因素。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Demand for sustainable seafood has encouraged some fishing communities to adopt methods that cause less damage to marine ecosystems.
word.example_zh: 对可持续海产品的需求促使一些渔业社区采用对海洋生态系统破坏较小的捕捞方式。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
